statusHistory.note: NITE-PORTER accommodation and city-culture page. Google Maps listing verified at the time of publication: Michelberger Hotel, Warschauer Str. 39-40, 10243 Berlin; listing pin copied exactly. Research floor: official hotel rooms and current calendar, Time Out, Condé Nast Traveler, The Berliner, recent Reddit discussion, and Google Maps listing/review summary checked. Google Trends DE/GB/TH travel feeds were attempted but returned fetch errors, so no trend claims were made. PEOPLE Festival is confirmed at the hotel for 10–11 October 2026; it is noted as a live calendar item, not treated as a separate event page because the available source does not yet substantiate a standalone editorial entry. Hero is clearly disclosed as an AI-generated, non-documentary illustration.
